guarantees.claim: wipe_secret is driven continuously equal to reg2hw.wipe_secret.qe.
wipe_v is driven continuously equal to reg2hw.wipe_secret.q.
digest_size_started_d takes digest_size when hash_start_or_continue is true, otherwise holds digest_size_started_q.
key_length_supplied equals cfg_reg.key_length.q cast to key_length_e.
msg_write is asserted when msg_fifo_req, msg_fifo_we, ~hmac_fifo_wsel, and msg_allowed are all true.

err_valid is asserted when hmac_err interrupt is not already set and any of hash_start_sha_disabled, update_seckey_inprocess, hash_start_active, msg_push_not_allowed, or invalid_config_atstart is true.

assumptions.claim: msg_allowed must be deasserted when message writes are not permitted by the HMAC state (e.g., during digest transfer or post-key load).
assumptions.cond: when HMAC logic does not allow data input
assumptions.risk: a message write could inject data at an illegal time, corrupting the HMAC operation or bypassing security checks.

assumptions.claim: cfg_reg.key_length.q must hold a valid key length value matching the digest mode; otherwise key_length_supplied casts an invalid length.
assumptions.risk: invalid key length can lead to incorrect key expansion, cryptographic weakness, or functional failure.

assumptions.claim: msg_fifo_req and msg_fifo_we must be deasserted when the FIFO is full or not ready, otherwise spurious msg_write assertions may occur.
assumptions.risk: data overrun or write to a full FIFO, causing data corruption.

assumptions.claim: The error condition signals in err_valid must remain stable long enough for the interrupt register to sample or must be otherwise latched; combinational glitches could cause missed or spurious err_valid.
assumptions.cond: when an error event occurs and hmac_err is not already set
assumptions.risk: interrupt may not be asserted, losing error notification.

uncertain_points.claim: The generation of msg_allowed is outside this chunk; if it is asserted incorrectly, a message write can be injected when unsafe.
uncertain_points.cond: when msg_allowed is mismatched with HMAC state
uncertain_points.risk: data corruption or security bypass by writing to HMAC core at wrong time.

uncertain_points.claim: Combined error conditions for err_valid may be pulses; if a pulse occurs and hmac_err interrupt is cleared, the interrupt might not be captured, missing an error.
uncertain_points.cond: when a transient error condition appears
uncertain_points.risk: undetected error could lead to silent failure or security breach.

uncertain_points.claim: digest_size_started_d captures digest_size when hash_start_or_continue is asserted; it is ambiguous if digest_size must be stable before that edge or can change during the start window.
uncertain_points.risk: an inconsistent digest size may be captured, causing an HMAC mismatch.

uncertain_points.claim: key_length_supplied is combinational from a CSRs; no protection against mid-operation CSR change exists in this chunk, which could alter the key length during HMAC processing.
uncertain_points.risk: key length change mid-stream could break HMAC computation.

uncertain_points.claim: wipe_secret and wipe_v are driven from register fields but no local wipe logic is present; actual secret deletion relies on external logic and may be incomplete or bypassed.
uncertain_points.risk: secrets may not be reliably removed.
